overloads.semanticRole: The Get printed height command returns the overall height (in pixels) of the section printed using the Print form command.

constraints: Returned height is in pixels, between 0 (top edge of the page) and the overall printable-area height returned by GET PRINTABLE AREA; if a new Print form section doesn't fit in the remaining printable area, a new page is generated and 0 is returned.
Only the top and bottom printable margins (settable via SET PRINTABLE MARGIN) affect the value returned; the left/right margins do not.
